caption: The drawing depicts a large, lidded tankard shown in three-quarters view. The tankard is cylindrical, tapering slightly towards the bottom, and includes a domed lid with a thumb lever for opening, attached to a single, thick C-shaped handle. The thumb lever is ornately detailed and positioned at the top of the handle near the lid, while the handle includes a lower curved rest or support. The base of the tankard features two concentric ridges, matching the style of the lid. The main drawing is rendered in grayscale pencil with careful shading to illustrate the reflective surface and contours of the tankard. In the top left corner, there is a small inset detail of the scalloped decorative edge, while the bottom right corner contains a smaller schematic side view with dimension markings, labeled with "6" for height and "4 7/8" for the base diameter. The overall composition is centered on the main object, with the insets framed within the boundaries of the paper. The background is plain and uncolored, and the lines are clean and precise.
title: Silver Tankard
